why: New UNE Newtype-lab classification given to Shagia and Olba Frost: their Twins Synchronization telepathy was undetectable by the Flash System, so the lab dismissed them as 'Category F' (F for 'Fake'). Not previously in any glossary file; appears repeatedly in Shagia's and Olba's battle shouts (e.g. dialogue_14507, dialogue_14580) as the brothers' bitter self-designation and grievance against the world. Confirmed on a second source, https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Shagia_Frost, which frames the same rejection story.
